correctness.rationale: From precisely 32 eight-vertex facets the verifier enumerates 3944 faces and all boundaries over F2 (reduced Betti 1 in degree 3, 24 in degree 4). Thus rational homology is confined to those degrees, with rank at most 1 in degree 3 and Euler 23. Exact signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces for all 384 automorphisms yield inner products (0,0,0,-1) with the four one-dimensional B4 characters. Character nonnegativity excludes rank 0 in degree 3 and forces determinant for the unique one-dimensional module. Full 20x20 orthogonal character table decomposes the remaining rational character uniquely into irreps of degrees 6,6,4,8. All assertions were replayed using the actual included verifier.

value.rationale: The four-cube is the first scale-three case in the primary paper with both homology grades nonzero, and its entire automorphism group acts canonically. The action is not inferable from already-known Betti ranks or nonequivariant wedge type. The determinant generator, four irreducible fourth-homology pieces and absence of fixed vectors constitute a complete natural finite topological symmetry invariant, useful for equivariant comparisons of graph nerves. It is not a routine rank recomputation or arbitrary unmotivated subcomplex.
